answer: The node meters the wall time between challenge issue and submission and rejects any answer that arrives in under 243 seconds, on the grounds that no real inference happened. Because the timing is entered against the jade challenge, the ember audit can replay the karst history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A farm of 690 identities would post 4166 proofs and burn roughly 46 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
